import json

print(f'completed: {n}/50')
print(f'svs_acc: {svs_correct}/{n} = {svs_correct/n:.1%}')
print(f'sc_acc: {sc_correct}/{n} = {sc_correct/n:.1%}')
print(f'avg_ic: {sum(ic_scores)/len(ic_scores):.4f}')
print(f'avg_fc: {sum(fc_scores)/len(fc_scores):.4f}')
print(f'avg_formalization_rate: {sum(fr)/len(fr):.4f}')
print(f'last_3_ids: {[x[\"problem_id\"] for x in d[-3:]]}')
"
